name: Team Bulbasaur: Glacial Lance & Dragon-Slaying Bulwark
archetype: 4x Ice super-effective dragon execution, Sleep status pacification, and Fighting wallbreaking.
gym_duel_rationale: Clair's 5v5 dragon duel prompts the player to select 5 active Pokémon from the party: Lapras rotates into the duel core as the primary dragon slayer, using STAB Ice Beam to land devastating 4x super-effective OHKOs on both Donphan/Dragonair and ace Garchomp/Aerodactyl; Venusaur/Charizard levels to Cap 68 to command the frontline, using Sleep Powder to instantly shut down Dragon Dance setup while melting Glaceon/Kingdra and Ariados/Charizard with STAB Flamethrower; Kingler/Primeape enters the duel core to deliver lethal STAB Close Combat against Glaceon/Kingdra; Gyarados/Arbok applies Intimidate to blunt physical assault and batters foes with Aqua Tail; and Alakazam/Weezing leverages Levitate to ignore Ground attacks while executing Ariados/Charizard with STAB Psychic.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST starter hybrid elevated to Cap 68. Sleep Powder shuts down opposing Dragon Dance boosts. STAB Flamethrower melts Glaceon/Kingdra and Ariados/Charizard.
